text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What I want, huh... A speed-specialized 
Umamusume who's willing to drink my new 
medicines, I suppose. For example, you and 
Believe-kun next to you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you an annual pass to the cat 
café in return.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. "No." Believe told me to 
refuse if you proposed giving me something 
in return.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see. Now I understand why you followed 
me, Believe. A watchdog of sorts, I 
presume?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I just don't want to get caught in the 
crossfire.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Then, which Umamusume will drink my 
previous concoction? I've already tested 
it on a few subjects; the only side effect 
is glowing a bit.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"No." Believe told me to turn down 
anything related to medication.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
......Then, I'd like your training match 
data. A thousand... No, a hundred runs 
should suffice.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Dishes that take too much time are also, 
well... ...Instead, how about a 'recipe 
for a traditional dish that boosts 
vitality'?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
......No, wait, this isn't bad at all. It 
could serve as a foothold for my next 
development. —Do tell!
